GENERAL TOLERANCE CANNOT DETERMINE — SEE PRINT / DFM NOTES UNLESS STATED.
ORIENTATION: upright, Z-up (8 x 20 x 58 mm)
THINNEST WALL, WHOLE SOLID (RAY MINIMUM): 0.0280 mm — a
distance through material, NOT a printable wall where it
falls on an edge, a fillet run-out or a chamfer tip.
Printability is judged on the next line.
PRINTABLE MINIMUM WALL: 1.0000 mm (smallest median wall
floor (2 perimeters @ 0.4 mm nozzle): VERDICT PASS
15 horizontal bore(s) bridge at the crown: ream any
bearing or press-fit bore to size
ORIGINAL MATERIAL / SURFACE FINISH: CANNOT DETERMINE; obtain original
FASTENER LENGTH / TORQUE / FIT CLASS: CANNOT DETERMINE; verify
interface stack and test production coupon.
every row measured off the solid; positions are model
